Author: attick, perchbird, Speedas, RokasKil, YyLlBbYy
Name: Title Edit Chronicle
Punchline: The title screen that follows your story — even on Free Trial, without a relaunch.
Description:
A Title Edit fork that tracks the currently logged-in character's Main Scenario and sets the matching vanilla title screen and idle movie for the next lobby.

Unlike the 7.1 built-in option, this follows the character you just played (not the furthest on the account), works on Free Trial, and applies as soon as you log out — no client relaunch.

All original Title Edit features remain: custom title and character select presets, sharing, last-location recording, and mounts.
